Half Butterfly Victory Blueprint by Adam.overview: Gi Super Grand Slam champion Adam Wardziński's half butterfly guard (half guard with a butterfly hook), six parts. Part 1 covers the position, set-up and core sweeps. Part 2 builds a sweeping system (the John Wayne sweep and connecting the hook sweep to it). Part 3 covers common problems and countering the knee cut. Part 4 covers attacks and counters to passes (clamp guard options, the loop choke). Part 5 covers advanced reactions when they control your bottom leg (choi bar, overhead sweep). Part 6 covers entries and guard pulling into half butterfly (sleeve grip control).
Half Butterfly Victory Blueprint by Adam.for: Gi half guard players, especially bigger or heavier ones.
key: Hook sweep and John Wayne sweep

Half Guard - BJJ Fundamentals - Go Furth.overview: John Danaher's gi half guard fundamentals in eight volumes. Volume 1 is the overview of bottom half guard. Volume 2 covers the 'paradox' of half guard and the alignment problem. Volume 3 covers the single elbow escape series (including into the shoulder crunch). Volume 4 covers getting to underhooks and winning from them (the tight waist series). Volume 5 covers the 90-degree rule and the knee lift. Volume 6 covers the tight waist versus whizzer battle. Volume 7 covers lapel single legs from half guard. Volume 8 covers the knee lever series.
Half Guard - BJJ Fundamentals - Go Furth.for: Gi players at any level, especially older grapplers who rely on half guard.
key: Alignment and the half guard paradox
Lapel single legs and knee levers

Heath Pedigo Geekological Approach： Intr.overview: Heath Pedigo's 'Geekological Approach' introduction to jiu-jitsu, four parts, showing how his Daisy Fresh team structures learning with techniques plus small games. Part 1 covers standing (grips and techniques). Part 2 covers half guard (getting to closed guard, half guard passing). Part 3 covers side control (games for holding the pin, side control escapes). Part 4 covers submissions (back chokes and others).
Heath Pedigo Geekological Approach： Intr.for: Beginners and coaches interested in a games-based way of learning.

Helena Crevar Leg Locks - Entries.overview: Teenage leg lock specialist Helena Crevar's entries course, five parts. Part 1 covers the positions (irimi ashi, outside ashi and others). Part 2 covers entries against an opponent on one knee or in a split squat (shin-to-shin to irimi or cross ashi). Part 3 covers standing opponents (double leg to ashi, shin-to-shin sweep to cross ashi). Part 4 covers entries from top (leg drag to cross ashi, split squat knee slide to ashi). Part 5 covers leg locks from defence (against berimbolo attempts, back escape to 'double trouble').
Helena Crevar Leg Locks - Entries.for: No-gi grapplers learning to get into leg entanglements.
key: Entries vs kneeling and split squat
